title: Roast Chicken with Dutch Potatoes
description: A moist and flavorful roast chicken paired with crispy Dutch potatoes. Perfect for a weeknight dinner.
instructions: Rinse the chicken and pat it dry with paper towels.
Season the chicken with salt, pepper, and thyme.
Heat the olive oil in a large oven-safe skillet over medium-high heat.
Sear the chicken on all sides until browned, about 5 minutes.
Transfer the skillet to the preheated oven and roast for 20-25 minutes, or until the chicken reaches an internal temperature of 165°F (74°C).
Toss the potatoes with olive oil, salt, and pepper in a separate bowl.
Spread the potatoes in a single layer on a baking sheet.
Roast the potatoes in the oven for 20-25 minutes, or until crispy and golden brown.
Remove the chicken from the oven and let it rest for 5 minutes before carving.
Serve the chicken with the roasted potatoes and drizzle with chicken broth.
